basis: Read-only successor audit of inventory.v4.json, current launchers, package scripts, CI workflows, and source imports. Active means a documented, packaged, CI, systemd, or shell entrypoint can execute it; historical oracle/comparison modules are excluded unless an active route invokes them.

statuses.VERIFIED_NATIVE: A native route has current checked verification for its declared bounded scope.
statuses.NATIVE_CANDIDATE_UNVERIFIED: A current TypeScript implementation exists in the dirty working tree but is not evidence of complete route closure.
statuses.PYTHON_ACTIVE_BLOCKER: An active route still executes owned Python and lacks a verified complete native replacement.
statuses.PARTIAL_ROUTE: A native counterpart exists but an active Python, packaging, deployment, or missing-capability branch remains.
statuses.HISTORICAL_ORACLE_ONLY: Not an active route; retained only as a bounded comparison/oracle.
